title: Telepathic escape plan with cousin Ian

tellings.quote: communicate he communicated to me telepathically he said on the count of

plain: The UFO investigator James Fox says that once, in downtown San Francisco, his cousin, named only as Ian, sent him a message by telepathy, mind to mind, laying out a plan to get away: "on the count of" three, as Fox puts it. Fox tells it to Michels as something he lived through himself, and it would mean the two cousins shared a link beyond ordinary words.
